title: Stop expired consumables inflating later-lot waste
prompt:
Fix the first-expiring-first-out consumption simulation in lib/ohworks-consumable-inventory.ts only. Lines 312-327 subtract cumulativeBeforeLot from demand but then add each lot's entire quantity, including stock that expires unused. Verified reproduction: usage 10/day, lot A containing 100 units expiring in one day, and lot B containing 20 units expiring in three days reports A waste 90 and B waste 20. B should have zero waste: days two and three consume its 20 units after A expires. The facility panel displays these incorrect waste quantities at app/pilot/ohworks/_components/facility-readiness-panel.tsx:136.

Track cumulative quantity actually consumed from earlier lots, excluding their discarded remainder, when calculating demand available to later lots. Preserve input/output order, expiry sorting, zero-usage behavior, null expiry behavior, and all stock/reorder calculations. Do not modify the panel or shared helpers.

Add tests/ohworks/consumable-expiry-consumption.test.ts covering the reproduced two-lot case, three successive expiries, tied expiry dates, zero daily usage, and a non-expiring final lot. Assert exact per-lot waste and total waste, including 90 total rather than the reproduced 110. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/consumable-expiry-consumption.test.ts tests/ohworks/consumable-inventory.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-facility-readiness-view.test.ts. Use synthetic data only; work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only the named production file and new test. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, auth changes, commits, or pushes.
